purpose: Two-annotator diagnostic QC; not official GT validation or model selection
context_required_for_review: Grades 2/3 only; absence is missing, never current-frame-sufficient
near_degenerate_reason: Less than two preview pixels cannot express a visible composition; not a competition crop-size rule
crop_policy: At most one coherent free-ratio window on grade 2/3; no crop requires low/no-feasible confidence and a reason
density_policy: No count, percentage, or deduplication quota; adjacent key moments may all receive grade 3
draft_policy: Never merge drafts into formal labels
mutation_policy: QC only reads snapshots and never rewrites human labels
independent_unit: Original source video; four new matched-protocol overlap sources are primary, two legacy smoke sources reported separately
